_note: Static wiki reference data for crop growth/pricing, plus a farm-tile-memory crosswalk. Not memory-derived except 'id' and 'distinct_stages'. Grass Seedling excluded intentionally. 'icon' filenames live in assets/crop_icons/ (a folder deliberately separate from assets/farm/ -- assets/farm/*.png are live-game screenshot captures used by the Farm Map's tile renderer for non-crop assets (map template, tile-state/debris/large-object icons -- see data/tables/farm_map.json's CROP_ICON_FILES), not wiki icons; downloading wiki icons into that same folder risked silently overwriting a confirmed live asset. Every crop-type id, including Turnip (id 0), now renders from its wiki icon here -- the Farm Map's old Turnip.png screenshot override in farm_map.json's CROP_ICON_FILES was removed and the file deleted for visual consistency with every other crop). 'id' is the farm tile's internal crop-type index (0-22 range, distinct from enums.json's general ITEM ids) that the Farm Map reads from memory to know which crop occupies a tile -- see data/tables/farm_map.json's CROP_ICON_FILES. CONFIRMED LIVE (via a full-height test column planted per id, then visually matched in-game): every id below, 0-22, is now confirmed -- the full crop-type index range is completely mapped. 'True Magic Red Flower' is a NEW row not on the wiki's crop list -- confirmed live to be its own distinct content id (20), separate from Blue Magic Red Flower (19), even though both grow from the same Magic Red Flower seed (the seed can rarely produce this rarer variant instead); its growth/regrowth/seed_price/get_from are copied from the Blue Magic Red Flower row since there's no separate wiki entry for it; its 'icon' (True Magic Red Flower.png) was downloaded from stratswiki's Blue Magic Red Flower page (https://stratswiki.com/sos-fomt/items/crops/blue-magic-red-flowers/, which covers both variants). Sunsweet Flower confirmed live as id 22, right after Toy Flower (id 21) in the test planting -- the last open id. 'distinct_stages' is how many of the 5 growth stages (occupant 1-5) look visually different in-game for that crop, counted by planting every crop at every stage side by side (app/farm_tile_debug.py's 'Plant All Crops - Stages 1-5'). Stage 5 is ALWAYS the harvestable one regardless of this number -- a crop with fewer distinct stages just repeats its last sprite for the skipped stage numbers (e.g. Turnip's stage 4 can look identical to its stage 5, but only stage 5 is actually harvestable) -- see data/pointer_map.md's 'Growth table' section. 'growth'/'regrowth' are in days; 'regrowth' is null for crops that don't regrow. 'seed_price' is in Gold.
